messages:
Becca: Heads up Quasar Labs sent invoice INV-2026-405 for $22,450 but it references PO QL-9001 which we already paid last month. PDF attached. Can AP hold to avoid double-pay? /cc @Sam @Procurement

ap-bot: invoice INV-2026-405 uploaded to AP queue (invoices/2026/Quasar_INV-2026-405.pdf). auto-pay: true

Sam: AP here I can freeze it. If it's a duplicate we need vendor confirmation. Please confirm the original paid invoice number. Also need GL/cost center.

Becca: Original payment was INV-2026-333 (paid 2026-02-14) against PO QL-9001 for $20,000. This new invoice is $22,450 and lists different line items (additional support hours) but vendor used the same PO number.

Procurement: Searching records PO QL-9001 exists; it was closed after full invoice paid. We did not expect further charges against that PO. Contract SOW 3 allows ad-hoc support but vendor should reference a new PO or provide a credit/adjustment reference.

Janelle: Could be vendor mistake: either a separate new invoice should reference a new PO or it should be a credit memoto adjust the previous invoice. I'll ask Quasar to clarify: are these new charges or a correction?

Becca: Message sent to billing@quasarlabs.ai: "INV-2026-405 references PO QL-9001 which appears closed and previously paid (INV-2026-333). Please confirm whether INV-2026-405 is a new charge (please reference a new PO) or a correction/credit to prior invoice. We will hold payment until clarified."

Sam: Placed manual hold: HOLD_POSS_DUP and created AP ticket AP-6722. Auto-pay disabled for this invoice.

Marta: If vendor confirms new charge, Procurement needs to open PO amendment or new PO. If it's a correction, AP needs credit note before releasing funds.

Janelle: Quasar replied (automated): "Thanks, we'll investigate and respond within 48 hours. Contact: accounts@quasarlabs.ai"

Legal: If vendor insists they can bill against closed PO, we need contract clause and approval from Finance lead. Otherwise reject invoice.

Becca: Pasting invoice header for quick triage:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-405
Date: 2026-06-09
Amount: $22,450.00
PO: QL-9001
```

Sam: Will wait for vendor response. If they confirm new charge, Procurement please prepare PO request and route to Marta for approval. AP will not pay until either new PO is provided or credit note issued. Leaving :no_entry: reaction.

Becca: Will update thread when vendor confirms. For now invoice is on hold. :white_check_mark:
